hints.title: Opposite Direction Cancellation
hints.text: Moving up cancels moving down, and moving left cancels moving right. Returning to the origin requires balanced net displacements on both axes.

hints.title: Axis Balance Invariant
hints.text: The robot returns to (0, 0) if and only if the total count of U moves equals D moves, and the total count of L moves equals R moves.

hints.title: Coordinate Offset Verification Procedure
hints.text: Track horizontal coordinate x and vertical coordinate y initialized to zero. For each move character, adjust x or y accordingly. After processing all moves, check whether both x and y equal zero.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating full grid worlds or trajectory history uses unnecessary memory when only net displacement matters.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting character frequencies or coordinates runs in O(N) time and requires strictly O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that net position is zero if count(U) == count(D) and count(L) == count(R).
